en.headline: Schools handle average of 496 bullying cases a year, up 32 per cent
en.dek: Education Bureau figures show public schools averaged 496 cases annually from 2022 to 2025, compared with 377 in the previous three years.
body: Public primary and secondary schools in Hong Kong handled an average of 496 bullying cases each academic year between 2022 and 2025, a 32 per cent rise from the average of 377 cases recorded annually from 2019 to 2022, according to Education Bureau data.

The bureau previously told the Legislative Council that the numbers for the 2019-20, 2020-21 and 2021-22 school years were 411, 306 and 413 respectively. The figures cover both school bullying and cyberbullying.

A youth group said the increase reflected greater reporting driven by heightened awareness of mental health issues, while also noting that some students had difficulty distinguishing playful jokes from bullying behaviour.
The data were reported in the South China Morning Post on Sunday morning.

zh.headline: 公營中小學年均處理496宗欺凌個案 較前三年增三成二
zh.dek: 教育局數據顯示，2022至2025學年公營學校年均處理496宗欺凌個案，較2019至2022學年的377宗上升32%。
body: 教育局數據顯示，香港公營中小學在2022至2025學年期間，平均每年處理496宗欺凌個案，較2019至2022學年年均377宗上升百分之三十二。
教育局早前向立法會表示，2019-20、2020-21及2021-22學年的個案數目分別為411、306及413宗。有關數字包括校園欺凌及網絡欺凌。
有青年團體認為，個案增加與社會對精神健康關注提高、舉報意願上升有關，同時指出部分學生難以分辨玩笑與欺凌行為。
有關數據於周日早上由南華早報報道。
